name: tasks
description: Everything about one piece of work in one card: messages from different sessions, progress on the acceptance criteria and the main decisions. A new task with the /new-task command, from the key of an existing Jira task too.
why: Work often goes through several sessions, and the thread gets lost: where the last message is, what was decided, what is left. Here the history, the acceptance criteria and the decisions on the work are in one card. Cost: the plugin calls Claude Haiku itself (sorting your messages, a summary on request) — about 300 thousand tokens a day with 5 tasks and 7 hours of work, from the main Claude Code sign-in (not the pool); the same provider as the sessions. "Delete" hides a task, its conversation stays in the plugin's archive. It creates nothing in Jira itself.
